'''Norlin Wennen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the father of [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]] [[Besany Wennen]]. When Besany was ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, Norlin's [[Besany Wennen's mother|wife]] left them sometime after their vacation to the jewel-caves of [[Birsingrial]]. Norlin almost [[Marriage/Legends|remarried]] but the plan did not push through, much to the relief of Besany, who had trouble liking her almost stepsister.<ref name="o66" /> Norlin [[Death/Legends|died]] in a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] started.<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
